_nota: Medicines the screen can use (Person 5). 'principios_activos' are the active-ingredient names, in Spanish, that the interaction search looks for in the other medicine's technical sheet (case and accents are ignored). 'ficha' is true when the shared CIMA file (fragmentos_cima_2026-11-10_v3.json) has this medicine's technical sheet, so the model can search it. Only medicines with 'ficha' true can be chosen as a new medicine. Ingredient names were written from the medicine names; check them against the nomenclator. Registration 87970 is in the CIMA file but not in any patient file yet, so it still needs to be added. 'atc' holds each medicine's WHO ATC code. When data/processed/prescriptions.json is missing (for example on the shared link), Person 2's rules use these ATC codes and the ingredient names instead of the nomenclator codes.
